The draft has cut approximately 60-70% of the extracts. Several of these missing entries carry high signature weight.

**Key high-severity losses:**

- **Hawthorne entries** — authorial/intertextual significance.
- **"My God! Mr. Chace..."** (Essex) — present, good.
- **Scoresby tail passage** — absent, thematic/nautical.
- The **J. Ross Browne** entry is present but significantly compressed (the full call-and-response is truncated mid-dialogue), losing its distinctive voice.
